headline: Vessel Services request for review and discussion, plus a Marine Trade Center rent reduction update.
summary: The agenda also lists reports on finances, facilities, and the Portland Fish Exchange. The board may meet in executive session to review confidential lease information tied to the vessel request.
items: Financial update from Kaela Gonzalez, Program Coordinator
Facilities update from Phil DiPierro, Project Manager
Portland Fish Exchange subcommittee update from Matt Moretti, including the manager's report and a general manager update
Review and discussion of a Vessel Services request, with public comment; possible executive session on confidential lease information
Construction update on the Marine Trade Center rent reduction, from Heather Moretti, Waterfront Coordinator
Verbal staff update from Heather Moretti, Waterfront Coordinator
Other items not on the agenda

legal address. To help ensure your comment is submitted for the correct item,
